retailer_description"\"At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you're looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we've got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of cane sugar, ALOHA's protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day with no artificial ingredients or sugar alcohols. ALOHA's organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free (lactose-free), stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA Protein Bars are corn-free — our organic vegetable glycerin is derived from flax seed, not corn. ALOHA's organic, plant-based Chocolate Fudge Brownie protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic cocoa powder. The perfect protein bar for when you're between meetings, warming up for the gym (or cooling down!), on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar.\""

retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers provide the perfect alternative for those who want to enjoy the taste of craft beer without the hangover. Whether you’re craving a crisp IPA, a smooth golden, or a light, refreshing brew, we offer a wide range of styles to satisfy your taste buds. Made with the finest ingredients, our beers include malted barley, hops, yeast, water, and wheat, ensuring a well-balanced, flavorful brew. The secret behind our great taste lies in our careful brewing method, which allows us to craft each Non Alcoholic beer with the same passion and precision as traditional craft brews, while maintaining the same flavor. Perfect for those looking for a mindful alcohol alternative, our beers contain less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, making them suitable for any time of the day. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers are designed for active, health-conscious individuals who love the taste of brews but want to make mindful choices. Our Non Alcoholic beer selection includes classics like Run Wild IPA, Upside Dawn Golden, Athletic Lite, and Free Wave, with regular releases of unique styles and experimental brews that showcase our passion for innovation. Each brew is carefully crafted to provide the same depth of flavor you’d expect from a traditional craft beer, without the unwanted effects. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beer is your go-to drink. It’s a great fit for any lifestyle, whether you’re indulging in pizza, a salad, or grilling. Perfectly paired with a variety of meals, desserts, and activities, it’s a refreshing choice for anyone who wants to enjoy the taste of beer without the alcohol. With a variety of styles to choose from, including hazy IPAs and light and dark brews, there’s a flavor to suit every palate. From casual drinking to special occasions, Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers let you enjoy the best of both worlds: the refreshing taste of craft beer and the benefits of choosing a Non Alcoholic beverage."

retailer_description"Real ingredients never tasted so good! Inspired by a favorite seasonal dessert, limited edition Larabar Pumpkin Pie Fruit and Nut Bars are sweet, chewy, and made with just nine real ingredients. You'll love the mix of dates, cashews, apples, almonds, pumpkin, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, and ginger that deliver big flavor in a convenient bar. Whether it's part of your morning or an afternoon snack, Larabar Pumpkin Pie is an easy and delicious option you can feel good about eating. These bars have no sugar added (not a low calorie food; see nutrition information for sugar and calorie content). They're also plant based, gluten free, vegan, dairy free, kosher, Non-GMO Project Verified, and soy free. Plus, they have a good source of fiber (contains 6g of fat per serving). All of that in a simple, wholesome bar. Real indulgence just got easier with this crave-worthy blend of fruit and nuts. 100% Real. 100% Delicious. Contains one regular cardboard box of Limited Edition Larabar Pumpkin Pie Fruit and Nut Bars, 6 bars, 9.6 oz; perfect for instant snacking."

retailer_description"Jack & Annie’s Plant Based Buffalo Wings: Do you want to enjoy delicious meaty flavors without the health and environmental downsides? These are buffalo-style frozen vegan chicken wings that can be cooked in the microwave or oven. What’s better? The jackfruit in our non-GMO, vegetarian/vegan plant-based foods is organically grown & is earth-friendly! Use these meatless meat wings to bring life to your food or next game night. Together, with Jack, we found a way to eat less meat with more joy."

retailer_description"GIOVANNI's 2chic Ultra-Moist Conditioner is powered by our Dual Moisture Complex of Avocado and Olive Oil that helps to add significant moisture, strength and shine for healthier and more lustrous locks that you can style with confidence. This ultra moisturizing Conditioner silkens coarse hair with softness and shine. Look in the Ingredients section for a listing of *USDA certified organic ingredients.GIOVANNI was the first full-range, salon-inspired hair-care brand in natural product stores, and today is the #1 selling Hair Care line in the United States Natural Products Industry. But before there was a brand, there was a pioneer. Arthur Guidotti had a vision and a love for all things hair. He began developing his passion as a hairstylist in Hollywood and Beverly Hills. He worked for a time with hairstylist icon Gene Shacove and was good friends with “the father of hair color,” Al Lapin . By the 1960s, Arthur was maturing his talents and decided to open his own salon, called On Sunset. The salon was a bustling site, on the famous Sunset Strip, and a hit with many Hollywood celebrities, including Lucille Ball . Since 1979 the GIOVANNI Rule of Balance has been our commitment to make each product as pure and as natural as possible without sacrificing exceptional product performance. GIOVANNI is committed to creating only the highest-performance formulations, wrapped in aesthetically beautiful packaging and marketed with extraordinary visuals and graphics."

retailer_description"What makes this the #1 plant protein powder brand in the U.S.^? Is it the smooth and creamy flavor? The delicious taste without the grit? The fact that it serves up 21 grams* of organic, vegan protein? Or that it's so easy to prepare? Truthfully, it's all of this and so much more. Our protein blend consists of organic peas, brown rice, and chia seeds, to provide a complete protein with all nine essential amino acids. Not only does our plant-based protein powder serve up the tastiest, creamiest protein, but it's also made with clean ingredients and higher standards in mind! Enjoy a protein powder that's certified USDA organic, non-GMO, and made without soy, dairy, gluten, or artificial preservatives, sweeteners or flavors. On top of all of that, it boasts 4-7g* of prebiotic + fiber, 0-1g of sugar*, and has 150 -190 calories.* Plus, when it comes to flavor and versatility, this powder delivers. Mix our plant-based protein powders with your favorite smoothies, almond or oat milk, and even baking mixes to add a good, clean boost. At Orgain we celebrate taste, and we take it seriously because we recognize that part of living a vibrant life is loving what you eat. Go ahead, fuel up with the powder that's a treat for both your taste buds and your body so you can have energy to keep on going!  ^Source: IRI, Total US MULO, Latest 52 weeks ending 10.30.22 *per serving, varies by flavor"

retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers provide the perfect alternative for those who want to enjoy the taste of craft beer without the hangover. Whether you’re craving a crisp IPA, a smooth golden, or a light, refreshing brew, we offer a wide range of styles to satisfy your taste buds. Made with the finest ingredients, our beers include malted barley, hops, yeast, water, and wheat, ensuring a well-balanced, flavorful brew. The secret behind our great taste lies in our careful brewing method, which allows us to craft each Non Alcoholic beer with the same passion and precision as traditional craft brews, while maintaining the same flavor. Perfect for those looking for a mindful alcohol alternative, our beers contain less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, making them suitable for any time of the day. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers are designed for active, health-conscious individuals who love the taste of brews but want to make mindful choices. Our Non Alcoholic beer selection includes classics like Run Wild IPA, Upside Dawn Golden, Athletic Lite, and Free Wave, with regular releases of unique styles and experimental brews that showcase our passion for innovation. Each brew is carefully crafted to provide the same depth of flavor you’d expect from a traditional craft beer, without the unwanted effects. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beer is your go-to drink. It’s a great fit for any lifestyle, whether you’re indulging in pizza, a salad, or grilling. Perfectly paired with a variety of meals, desserts, and activities, it’s a refreshing choice for anyone who wants to enjoy the taste of beer without the alcohol. With a variety of styles to choose from, including hazy IPAs and light and dark brews, there’s a flavor to suit every palate. From casual drinking to special occasions, Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers let you enjoy the best of both worlds: the refreshing taste of craft beer and the benefits of choosing a Non Alcoholic beverage."
